name: D09_4_declining_the_may_does_nothing_and_does_not_shuffle
notes: Printed: 'you MAY search your library ... then shuffle.' A mana value 7 creature sits on top of my library. I decline the may (skip): nothing is searched, nothing moves to my hand, and the library is not shuffled: it keeps its exact order, the creature on top of the six fillers.
